text:
Hi there,

I'm planning something epic and I need your help - I'd like to hire the Castellan for a period drama shoot. We'd love to pick it up on Saturday 5 June 2027 at 2 pm and then drop it off on Monday 7 June 2027 at 6:30 pm. Can you meet us at Studio 9, Quarry Lane and take it from there afterwards? The Castellan is going to be a part of a really cool shoot, it's a period drama, and I think it's going to be a lot of fun.

Cheers,
Zane Corbyngton
